copy.tagline: 遵循测试驱动开发流程分阶段完成开发任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要按测试驱动方式规范地完成开发任务
copy.tagline_en: Follow a test-driven development workflow to complete development tasks in phases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to follow a strict test-driven workflow in your development tasks.

howto.what: 按 Conductor 的 TDD 流程实现任务：先写失败测试（RED），把改动拆成小的 git 提交并附 notes，完成阶段检查点、执行验证协议，并把进度写回 plan.md。
howto.when: 当你按 track 的 plan.md 实现任务、走 TDD 红-绿-重构循环、完成阶段检查点、管理 git 提交，或处理验证协议时接管。

say.note: 先写失败测试再动代码

say.text: 把这次改动提交成一个 git commit，并写好 notes
say.note: 一次提交只含一个逻辑改动

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude implements tasks using Conductor's TDD flow: write failing tests first, make small git commits with notes, complete phase checkpoints, run the verification protocol, and record progress in plan.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you implement tasks from a track's plan.md, follow the TDD red-green-refactor cycle, finish phase checkpoints, manage git commits, or follow the verification protocol.

say_en.text: Implement the next task in plan.md following TDD
say_en.note: Writes a failing test first, then the code

say_en.text: Commit this change to git with a descriptive note
This phase is done - run the checkpoint verification
say_en.note: Marks complete only after gates pass
